services.name: 3D Scanning
services.tagline: Capture any part, product or space as an accurate digital model.
services.intro: We scan parts of every size with a range of professional 3D scanners — from small precision components to car bodies and full buildings. The result is a precise digital copy of the physical object, ready for product design, reverse engineering and quality control.
points: High-accuracy capture
Blue-laser and structured-light scanners record detail down to hundredths of a millimetre.
Any size, on site or in-house
From jewellery to vehicles and plant rooms — we bring the scanner to you when the part can't travel.
Clean, usable data
Scans are aligned, cleaned and merged into watertight meshes, not raw point dumps.
Ready for the next step
Data is prepared for reverse engineering, inspection, printing or visualisation.
faq: What accuracy can I expect for my part?
It depends on size, surface and setup. Share the part size and tolerance, and we'll tell you what's achievable and how we'll verify it.
Do shiny or black parts reduce accuracy?
They can be harder to scan. Blue-laser scanners handle many such surfaces well, and a light, removable matte spray is used when needed.
Is a higher-resolution scan more accurate?
Not necessarily. Resolution captures finer detail; accuracy is how close the measurements are to the true size. Both matter, but they are different.
Do you scan on site?
Yes. Large parts and installed equipment can be scanned at your facility in India or the UAE.
Can you scan highly polished gold jewellery?
Yes. Reflective surfaces need the right setup, and sometimes a temporary removable matte coating, which we discuss with you before scanning.
services.alt: Handheld 3D laser scanning of an engine cylinder head

services.name: Reverse Engineering
services.tagline: Turn scan data into fully editable, manufacturable CAD.
services.intro: We rebuild physical parts as parametric CAD models — for re-manufacturing legacy parts with no drawings, modifying existing designs, or creating moulds and tooling. You choose how faithful the model should be to the scanned part.
points: Design-intent modelling
A clean CAD model with manufacturing imperfections removed — ideal for re-manufacture from 3D models or 2D drawings.
NURBS surface models
Precise freeform surfaces fitted over scan data where an exact as-is representation matters.
Hybrid modelling
Prismatic features modelled to design intent, freeform areas surfaced to the scan — the best of both.
Drawings on request
2D manufacturing drawings with GD&T generated from the final model.
faq: What do I need to send to get a quote?

Clear photos of the part from several angles, approximate dimensions, the quantity you plan to make, and what you need delivered (CAD only, CAD and drawings, or inspection). If you have an old drawing, even a partial one, send that too.
Can you reverse engineer a broken or worn part?
Yes. We scan what remains and rebuild the missing or worn geometry using design intent, symmetry, mating parts and any information you can share.
Will the new part be identical to the original?
It will match the original design intent and fit. Where wear has changed the shape, we restore the original geometry rather than copying the wear.
Which CAD formats do you deliver?
STEP as standard, plus IGES, Parasolid and other neutral formats that open in SolidWorks, Creo, NX, CATIA and similar systems. We also supply the scan in STL.
Do you manufacture the replacement part as well?
We deliver CAD and drawings ready for manufacture. If needed, we can also coordinate 3D-printed prototypes or recommend manufacturing partners.
Do you scan on site?
Yes. Large parts and installed equipment can be scanned at your facility in India or the UAE.
services.alt: 3D scan to CAD reverse engineering of a motorcycle tubular frame

services.name: Scan to BIM
services.tagline: Existing buildings captured as accurate, intelligent BIM models.
services.intro: We laser-scan existing structures and convert the point cloud into detailed BIM models. Architects, engineers and contractors get an accurate as-built foundation for renovation, retrofit and facility-management projects — with every wall, slab, column and service documented.
points: As-built accuracy
Terrestrial laser scanning records the true geometry of the building, not the original drawings.
LOD 200–400 models
Walls, floors, structure and MEP modelled to the level of detail your project needs.
Clash-ready coordination
Models are set up for coordination with new design work in Revit and Navisworks.
Drawings from the model
Floor plans, sections and elevations exported straight from the BIM.
faq: Do you do the laser scanning for BIM projects?

Yes. Our team scans the building or plant room on site with terrestrial laser scanners suited to the space. If you already have a point cloud from your own survey team, we can model from that instead.
What software do you deliver BIM models in?
Autodesk Revit (RVT).
How accurate is a Scan to BIM model?
The point cloud itself is highly accurate. Model accuracy depends on the LOD and modelling tolerances agreed for the project, which we define at the scoping stage.
How do you price Scan to BIM?
By area or volume, complexity and LOD. Photos, any existing drawings and a short description of the site (or a sample of your point cloud) are enough for an initial estimate.
services.alt: Terrestrial laser scanning of an industrial pump room for Scan to BIM

services.name: Class A Surfacing
services.tagline: Flawless, curvature-continuous surfaces for visible parts.
services.intro: Class A surfaces are the visible skins of a product — car body panels, aircraft fairings, consumer-product housings. We build G2/G3-continuous surfaces with clean patch layouts and verify them with zebra and curvature analysis, so reflections flow without a ripple.
points: G2 / G3 continuity
Curvature-continuous transitions between every patch for perfect reflections.
Analysis-verified
Zebra stripes, highlight lines and curvature combs checked on every surface.
From scan or sketch
Start from a clay-model scan, a reference surface or concept sketches.
Tooling-ready
Surfaces handed over with draft, flanges and offsets ready for engineering.
faq: Can you create Class A surfaces from a 3D scan?
Yes. We scan the physical model or part, then build new Class A surfaces that follow the scan within an agreed tolerance, with clean G2/G3 continuity.
What's the difference between Class A surfacing and reverse engineering?
Reverse engineering focuses on accurate, manufacturable geometry. Class A surfacing adds strict control of surface continuity and reflection quality for visible surfaces.
Which file formats do you deliver?
Neutral formats such as STEP and IGES, which open in CATIA, NX, Alias and other platforms.
services.alt: Class A surface zebra stripe analysis of a car fender

services.name: Digital Metrology
services.tagline: Compare manufactured parts to their CAD — to the micron.
services.intro: We inspect manufactured parts by scanning them and comparing the result against the nominal CAD. Colour deviation maps, GD&T checks and first-article reports show exactly where a part is in or out of tolerance — fast, and without contact.
points: Colour deviation maps
Full-surface comparison against CAD, instantly showing where material is over or under.
GD&T inspection
Flatness, position, profile and more, measured and reported against the drawing.
First-article inspection
Complete FAI reports for new parts, tools and suppliers.
Trend analysis
Repeated inspections track tool wear and process drift over time.
faq: Is 3D scanning accurate enough to replace a CMM?
For most castings, moulded parts and freeform surfaces, yes. For micron-level machined features, a CMM is still the better tool, and many companies combine both.
What do you need from us for an inspection?
The part (or access to it on site), the CAD model, and the drawing or tolerances to check against. If there is no CAD, we can compare two parts against each other, or against a "golden" sample.
How long does a 3D inspection take?
Scanning a typical part takes minutes to an hour. Reporting depends on how many features and GD&T checks you need.
services.alt: 3D digital inspection deviation colour map of a cast transmission housing

services.name: 3D Printing
services.tagline: Rapid prototypes and functional parts, straight from your model.
services.intro: We print prototypes, fit-check models, jigs, fixtures and short-run end-use parts directly from CAD or scan data. Our team also prepares and repairs files — including sculpted character models — so they print right the first time.
points: Rapid prototyping
Physical parts in days to check form, fit and function before tooling.
FDM and SLA printing
FDM engineering plastics for strong parts, SLA resins for fine detail.
Print-ready preparation
Mesh repair, hollowing, supports and orientation handled for you.
Character & figure models
Digitally sculpted busts and figures prepared for high-detail resin printing.
faq: Which 3D printing processes do you offer?
FDM and SLA. FDM suits strong, functional parts and fixtures; SLA resin suits fine detail, smooth surfaces and jewellery masters.
Can you print directly from a 3D scan?
For decorative or artistic objects, often yes, after mesh cleanup. For engineering parts, we usually create CAD first, so the print is accurate and editable.
What file do I need to send for printing?
STEP or STL is ideal. If you only have a physical part, we can scan it for you.
How long does a prototype take?
Small parts can often be printed in a few days. Scanning and CAD work add time depending on complexity. Contact us with details for a timeline.

services.alt2: Resin 3D printed scale car, aircraft model and pendant

services.name: Product Rendering
services.tagline: Photoreal visuals that sell a product before it is ever made.
services.intro: We turn CAD and design models into photorealistic images and animations for marketing, presentations and design reviews. Materials, lighting and scenes are tuned so your product looks real — and looks its best — before the first unit is built.
points: Photoreal stills
Studio and lifestyle shots with accurate materials, finishes and lighting.
Animations & turntables
Exploded views, assembly sequences and 360° spins.
Interiors & exhibitions
Spaces, stands and environments visualised before construction.
Jewellery visualisation
Metals and gemstones rendered with true reflections and sparkle.
faq: What do you need to create a product render?
A CAD model or 3D scan of the product, plus reference photos or samples for materials, colours and finishes. If you only have sketches, we can model the product first.
Can you render a product that hasn't been made yet?
Yes, that is the main use. Renders made from CAD let you market, present or review a product before the first unit is built.
What can you deliver?
High-resolution stills, 360° turntables, exploded views and animations, plus web-ready image sets.
Do you render jewellery?
Yes. Metals and gemstones are rendered with true reflections and sparkle, so pieces can be shown and sold before they are made.
services.alt: Product rendering of wireless earbuds from clay model to photorealistic render

productFaq: What is the price of a 3D scanner in India?
Pricing depends on the model, software and accessories. Contact us for a current quotation for Vertex3D, Vertex3D Pro or Vertex Tracker.
Can I see the scanner working before I buy?
Yes. We offer demos on your own parts, so you can judge the data quality yourself.
Which model is best for an engineering college?
For teaching and research labs, the Vertex3D usually offers the best balance of capability and cost. It handles the wide range of student and research parts well.
What's included when I buy a scanner?
Our engineers install the scanner at your site and train your team when it's delivered. The scanner comes with a 12-month warranty.
Do you also supply scanners in the UAE?
Contact us with your location and requirements and we will advise on availability and support.
